name: Crater
tagline: Open source invoicing & expenses. Self-hosted, Laravel + Vue.
shortDescription: Self-hosted invoicing, expense tracking, and time billing. Laravel + Vue, PDF invoices, online payments, customer portal. The Wave/FreshBooks alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Crater is an open source invoicing and expense tracking app. Laravel backend, Vue frontend, REST API. Create/send invoices, track expenses, time billing, recurring invoices, online payments (Stripe, PayPal), customer portal.

## Why we recommend it

If you want invoicing without FreshBooks/QuickBooks fees, Crater is the cleanest open source option. The PDF invoices look great, the customer portal is polished, and the online payment integrations just work.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted invoicing for freelancers/small businesses
- Replacing FreshBooks or Wave
- Time + expense + invoice in one app
- Agencies billing clients monthly
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/crater-invoice/crater && cd crater && composer install
installInstructions:
**Manual install:**
1. LAMP/LEMP with PHP 8.1+
2. Clone the repo
3. `composer install`
4. Configure `.env`
5. `php artisan migrate --seed`
6. `php artisan serve`
pricingDetails: Free. Open source under AGPL-3.0. Self-host on LAMP/LEMP.
